core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ulvi is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Exalted, sublime”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ulvi corresponds to the Arabic form عُلْوِي (Arabic root ع ل و (ʿ-l-w); عُلْوِيّ (ʿUlwī)). Its core sense is ulvi; exalted, sublime (azerbaijani form). Ulvi is the Azerbaijani form of Arabic عُلْوِيّ (ʿUlwī), meaning 'exalted, sublime'.

persian.name: علوی
